videos.video_subject: Cristiano Ronaldo's very first club was CF Andorinha, a tiny amateur team in Santo Antonio, Funchal, where his father Jose Dinis Aveiro worked as the kit man; he joined aged seven and was quickly moved up to play against older boys
videos.video_script: His first club was a tiny team in his own neighbourhood. His father washed the kits there. Cristiano was seven years old. Within months, they stopped playing him against kids his own age.
